title: Consumption Anchors Stock Prices
title_zh: 消费锚定股票价格
title_primary: 消费锚定股票价格
title_secondary: Consumption Anchors Stock Prices
authors: Carlo A. Favero, Andrea Tamoni, Alessandro Melone, Sean Myers
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Aggregate stock prices and aggregate consumption share a common stochastic trend. We estimate this long-run relation in real time and recover a price--consumption cycle that captures transitory deviations of stock prices from their consumption-implied value. These deviations mean-revert over business-cycle horizons and predict future returns on the aggregate market and characteristics-sorted portfolios, both in- and out-of-sample, from one quarter to two years ahead. The cycle does not forecast consumption growth, but contains information about future dividend growth, and its return-predictive power disappears when consumption is excluded from the long-run relation. A simple model with permanent and transitory consumption shocks rationalizes these findings and the time variation in the estimated price--consumption loading. The evidence identifies consumption as a macroeconomic anchor for asset prices and departures from this anchor as a source of time-varying expected returns.

title: Occupational Licensing of Uber Drivers
title_zh: 优步司机的职业许可制度
title_primary: 优步司机的职业许可制度
title_secondary: Occupational Licensing of Uber Drivers
authors: Jonathan Hall, Jason Hicks, Morris M. Kleiner, Yun taek Oh
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine whether occupational licensing improves service quality and safety using trip-level Uber data that include driver ratings and telematics-based measures of driving behavior. Exploiting quasi-random assignment from proximity-based dispatch, we compare trips served by licensed and unlicensed drivers in two settings: a cross-border comparison between New York City and New Jersey, and a deregulation event in Houston. Across settings and specifications, including instrumental variable estimates, we find no consistent evidence that licensing improves consumer outcomes. In Houston, post-deregulation entrants are indistinguishable from previously licensed drivers on ratings and driving behavior, despite differing markedly in experience and age.
abstract_zh: 我们利用包含司机评分和基于远程信息处理的驾驶行为指标的Uber行程级数据，考察职业许可是否提升服务质量和安全性。借助基于邻近调度的准随机分配，我们在两种情境下比较持牌与无牌司机服务的行程：纽约市与新泽西州的跨境对比，以及休斯顿的放松管制事件。跨情境和规格（包括工具变量估计）中，我们发现没有一致证据表明许可改善消费者结果。在休斯顿，放松管制后进入者与先前持牌司机在评分和驾驶行为上难以区分，尽管他们在经验和年龄上差异显著。

title: The Heterogeneous Effects of Trade across Occupations: A Test of the Stolper-Samuelson Theorem
title_zh: 贸易对不同职业的异质性影响：斯托尔珀-萨缪尔森定理的检验
title_primary: 贸易对不同职业的异质性影响：斯托尔珀-萨缪尔森定理的检验
title_secondary: The Heterogeneous Effects of Trade across Occupations: A Test of the Stolper-Samuelson Theorem
authors: Sergi Basco, Maxime Liegey, Marti Mestieri, Gabriel Smagghue, Simone Arrigoni 等
official: 官方在线 2020-08-19 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper develops and implements a novel test of the Stolper-Samuelson theorem. We use nationally-representative matched employer-employee panel data from 1997 through 2015 to study the effect of the rise in China’s exports on French worker earnings. Our version of the Stolper-Samuelson theorem states that there is a negative correlation between occupation exposure to Chinese competition and change in worker earnings. First, we document substantial heterogeneity in trade adjustment across occupations. Then, consistent with the Stolper-Samuelson prediction, we show that workers initially employed in occupations more intensively used in hard-hit industries experience larger declines in earnings. We also show that workers tend to move out of hard-hit industries, but they tend to remain in their initial occupation
abstract_zh: 本文开发并实施了一项针对斯托尔珀-萨缪尔森定理的新检验。我们利用1997年至2015年间具有全国代表性的雇主-雇员匹配面板数据，研究中国出口增长对法国工人收入的影响。我们的斯托尔珀-萨缪尔森定理版本表明，职业暴露于中国竞争的程度与工人收入变化之间存在负相关关系。首先，我们记录了不同职业在贸易调整中的显著异质性。随后，与斯托尔珀-萨缪尔森预测一致，我们显示，最初在受冲击严重行业中密集使用的职业就业的工人，其收入下降幅度更大。我们还发现，工人倾向于离开受冲击严重的行业，但往往留在其初始职业中。

title: Developing a new European indicator of potential skill shortages
title_zh: 构建欧洲潜在技能短缺新指标
title_primary: 构建欧洲潜在技能短缺新指标
title_secondary: Developing a new European indicator of potential skill shortages
authors: Seamus McGuinness, Elisa Staffa, Lorcan Kelly, Paul Redmond, Sangwoo Lee
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Skill shortages are a type of skill mismatch whereby employers are unable to fill existing vacancies due to a lack of suitably qualified or skilled candidates. Despite representing a significant concern for policymakers, the literature on skill shortages is highly underdeveloped, as a result of a lack of clarity and consistency on how skill shortages are defined and measured. In this study, using data from the 2021 European Skills and Jobs Survey combined with Lightcast job advertisement data, we attempt to bridge the methodological gap by developing a measure of potential skill shortages that can be readily replicated across countries over time. Benchmarking an objective measurement approach to a dataset reflecting the current distribution of skills and competencies being utilized within the labour market constitutes, in our view, a novelty within the skill shortages measurement literature. We estimate that approximately two per cent of vacancies in the EU are likely to experience skill shortages. We find substantial variation in estimates across occupations and countries. Moreover, potential skill shortages tend to be in occupations within which the skill content is changing more rapidly over time. Acknowledgements We would like to express our gratitude to the participants of the Cedefop research conference ‘ Using data from the web to shape next-generation labour market and skills analysis’ , hosted by the European Economic and Social Committee (Brussels, April 2025) for their invaluable feedback and constructive suggestions.
abstract_zh: 技能短缺是一种技能错配类型，即雇主因缺乏具备适当资格或技能的候选人而无法填补现有职位空缺。尽管这已成为政策制定者关注的重要问题，但由于对技能短缺的定义和测量缺乏清晰性和一致性，相关文献仍极为不完善。本研究利用2021年欧洲技能与就业调查数据，结合Lightcast招聘广告数据，试图通过开发一种可随时跨国家、跨时间复制的潜在技能短缺测量方法来弥合方法论上的差距。我们认为，将客观测量方法对标于反映劳动力市场中当前技能与能力分布状况的数据集，是技能短缺测量文献中的一项创新。我们估计，欧盟约2%的职位空缺可能面临技能短缺。研究发现，不同职业和国家之间的估计值存在显著差异。此外，潜在技能短缺往往集中在技能内容随时间变化更快的职业中。致谢：我们谨向欧洲经济社会委员会主办的Cedefop研究会议“利用网络数据塑造下一代劳动力市场与技能分析”（布鲁塞尔，2025年4月）的与会者表示诚挚感谢，感谢他们宝贵的反馈和建设性建议。

title: Self-medication under uncertainty: Insights on drug quality and consumer behavior in Burkina Faso
title_zh: 不确定性下的自我用药：布基纳法索药品质量与消费者行为研究
title_primary: 不确定性下的自我用药：布基纳法索药品质量与消费者行为研究
title_secondary: Self-medication under uncertainty: Insights on drug quality and consumer behavior in Burkina Faso
authors: Renate Hartwig, Moumouni Koala, Lena Merkel, Salfo Ouedraogo, Fadima Yaya Bocoum
abstract: How does drug quality affect self-medication behavior? We address this question in the context of Burkina Faso, where self-medication with antibiotics is widespread. Using chemical quality tests, we find that one in three antibiotics on the market is substandard or falsified, posing significant health risks. While consumers are broadly aware of the prevalence of poor-quality drugs, they struggle to assess quality based on observable cues such as price or packaging. To identify causal effects, we conduct a novel lab-in-the-field experiment that varies the probability of purchasing effective medicine. We find that self-medication increases as drug quality becomes more certain. These results suggest that market-level interventions to improve drug quality may unintentionally increase inappropriate antibiotic use, with implications for health policy and antimicrobial resistance.
abstract_zh: 药物质量如何影响自我药疗行为？我们在布基纳法索的背景下探讨这一问题，该国抗生素自我药疗现象普遍。通过化学质量检测，我们发现市场上三分之一的抗生素为劣质或伪造药品，构成重大健康风险。尽管消费者普遍意识到劣质药物的普遍存在，但他们难以依据价格或包装等可观察线索评估药品质量。为识别因果效应，我们开展了一项新颖的实地实验，该实验改变了购买有效药物的概率。我们发现，随着药物质量确定性提高，自我药疗行为增加。这些结果表明，旨在改善药品质量的市场层面干预措施可能无意中加剧不当抗生素使用，这对卫生政策和抗菌素耐药性具有重要启示。

title: Automating Food Production: Evidence From the Dutch Food Industry
title_zh: 自动化食品生产：来自荷兰食品工业的证据
title_primary: 自动化食品生产：来自荷兰食品工业的证据
title_secondary: Automating Food Production: Evidence From the Dutch Food Industry
authors: Jan‐Philip R. Uhlemann
abstract: Automation technology has the potential to replace a significant part of the labour force in the food industry. With data from 2002 to 2023, I investigate the causal treatment effects of the adoption of automation technology in the Dutch food industry. Automation technology in the food industry is used in a variety of tasks, such as logistics, safety, quality and production. I present a theoretical model to outline relationships that are tested in the empirical analysis. The outcome variables of interest are gross value added, average wage, employment and the labour share. The empirical analysis finds that the effect of automation on these outcomes is ambiguous and the majority of the estimates are not statistically significant. I study the relationship under various samples of food industry firms and automation definitions. For the full sample, long‐run changes in these outcomes are largely uncorrelated with automation, while food processors show a long‐run decline in gross value added and a rising labour share. A chained difference‐in‐differences design shows that adoption raises gross value added and lowers the labour share and wages among larger firms and food processors. However, most of the effects of automation are not statistically significant. The absence of strong effects of automation could be explained by investments that monitor and control production steps, rather than displace worker roles in production.
abstract_zh: 自动化技术有潜力替代食品工业中相当一部分劳动力。利用2002年至2023年的数据，我研究了荷兰食品工业中采用自动化技术的因果处理效应。食品工业中的自动化技术被应用于多种任务，如物流、安全、质量和生产。我提出了一个理论模型来概述实证分析中检验的关系。关注的结果变量包括总增加值、平均工资、就业和劳动份额。实证分析发现，自动化对这些结果的影响并不明确，且大多数估计在统计上不显著。我在不同食品工业企业样本和自动化定义下研究了这一关系。对于全样本，这些结果的长期变化与自动化基本不相关，而食品加工企业则表现出总增加值的长期下降和劳动份额的上升。链式双重差分设计显示，在较大企业和食品加工企业中，采用自动化提高了总增加值，降低了劳动份额和工资。然而，自动化的大部分效应在统计上并不显著。自动化缺乏强烈效应可能归因于投资用于监控和控制生产步骤，而非替代工人在生产中的角色。

title: Time-Varying Model Averaging for FAVAR Models with Smooth Structural Changes
title_zh: FAVAR模型中含平滑结构变化的时变模型平均
title_primary: FAVAR模型中含平滑结构变化的时变模型平均
title_secondary: Time-Varying Model Averaging for FAVAR Models with Smooth Structural Changes
authors: Qitong Chen, Yongmiao Hong, Haiqi Li, Xia Wang
abstract: Factor-augmented vector autoregressive (FAVAR) models serve as a powerful tool for forecasting economic and financial variables, particularly in environments with a large number of predictors. In this study, we propose a time-varying model-averaging method for FAVAR (TVMA-FAVAR) that accommodates smooth structural changes. To estimate the optimal time-varying combination weights, we develop a local leave-one-out cross-validation (LLOCV) criterion that is asymptotically unbiased for the local mean squared error (LMSE), as it excludes a term irrelevant to the weight vector. We establish the asymptotic optimality of the TVMA-FAVAR method by demonstrating that its LMSE attains an infeasible lower bound. In addition, we derive the convergence rates of the selected weights and the TVMA-FAVAR estimator. Monte Carlo simulations show that the proposed method outperforms existing popular model averaging and selection approaches. An empirical application to forecasting U.S. macroeconomic variables further illustrates the superior predictive performance of the TVMA-FAVAR method.
abstract_zh: 因子增强向量自回归（FAVAR）模型在预测经济和金融变量方面是一种强有力的工具，尤其是在预测变量众多的情况下。在本研究中，我们提出了一种适用于FAVAR的时变模型平均方法（TVMA-FAVAR），该方法能够适应平滑的结构变化。为了估计最优的时变组合权重，我们开发了一种局部留一交叉验证（LLOCV）准则，该准则对于局部均方误差（LMSE）是渐近无偏的，因为它排除了与权重向量无关的一项。我们通过证明TVMA-FAVAR方法的LMSE达到一个不可行的下界，确立了其渐近最优性。此外，我们推导了所选权重和TVMA-FAVAR估计量的收敛速率。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，所提出的方法优于现有的流行模型平均和选择方法。一项针对美国宏观经济变量预测的实证应用进一步展示了TVMA-FAVAR方法的优越预测性能。

title: Education and Partisanship
title_zh: 教育与党派立场
title_primary: 教育与党派立场
title_secondary: Education and Partisanship
authors: Firoozi, Daniel
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Applied Economics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Education weakens the historical link between income and partisanship across democracies, challenging classical models of political economy. Using administrative data on millions of voters exposed to discontinuities in compulsory schooling laws and college admissions in Florida and California, I show that both the extensive margin of years of high school education and the intensive margin of college selectivity can reduce Republican Party affiliation. Effects generalize across generations (1969 to present), settings, and institutions. Results are consistent with peer socialization shaping sociocultural attitudes alongside career-path mechanisms, rather than deliberate instructor-driven persuasion.
abstract_zh: 教育削弱了民主国家中收入与党派归属之间的历史联系，对经典政治经济学模型构成挑战。利用佛罗里达州和加利福尼亚州数百万选民受义务教育法和大学录取断点影响的行政数据，我证明高中教育年限的广度边际和大学选择性的强度边际均能减少共和党归属。效应在代际（1969年至今）、情境和制度间具有普遍性。结果与同伴社会化塑造社会文化态度及职业路径机制相一致，而非教师有意的说服所致。

title: Copeland choice rules
title_zh: 科普兰选择规则
title_primary: 科普兰选择规则
title_secondary: Copeland choice rules
authors: Bhavook Bhardwaj, Kriti Manocha
abstract: Tournaments are well studied objects in economic theory. Copeland (1951 A reasonable social welfare function. Tech. rep., Mimeo, University of Michigan USA")) provides an intuitive way to select alternatives from a tournament, the Copeland set . As a tournament solution, the Copeland set possesses many desirable properties and has been widely studied. Rubinstein (1980 Ranking the participants in a tournament. SIAM J Appl Math 38:108–111")) axiomatizes a method to rank alternatives from a tournament which is based on their Copeland scores . This paper analyzes the Copeland set from a revealed preference perspective. A choice procedure where a decision maker has a fixed underlying tournament and selects the Copeland set from every menu is behaviorally characterized.
abstract_zh: 锦标赛是经济理论中研究较为深入的对象。Copeland（1951，《一种合理的社会福利函数》，技术报告，密歇根大学，美国）提出了一种从锦标赛中筛选备选方案的直观方法，即Copeland集。作为一种锦标赛解概念，Copeland集具备诸多理想性质，并得到了广泛研究。Rubinstein（1980，《锦标赛参与者排序方法》，《SIAM应用数学杂志》第38卷，第108–111页）基于Copeland得分公理化了锦标赛备选方案的排序方法。本文从显示偏好视角分析Copeland集。研究对一种选择程序进行了行为特征刻画：在该程序中，决策者拥有固定的潜在锦标赛结构，并从每个备选菜单中选取Copeland集。

title: An Evaluation of Protected Area Policies in the European Union
title_zh: 欧盟保护区政策评估
title_primary: 欧盟保护区政策评估
title_secondary: An Evaluation of Protected Area Policies in the European Union
authors: Tristan Grupp, Prakash Mishra, Mathias Reynaert, and Arthur A. van Benthem
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The European Union designates 26% of its landmass as protected areas, limiting economic development for biodiversity. We use the staggered introduction of protected areas between 1985 and 2019 to study the selection of protected land and the causal effect of protection on vegetation cover and nightlights. We find no meaningful impacts on either outcome across four decades, countries, protection cohorts, or land characteristics. These null effects are consistent with the political economy of EU land protection: weak incentives to internalize biodiversity gains, green-glow motives, and area-based targets shape local siting and stringency choices. In practice, strict protection is applied where development pressure is low–so that protection has little bite—while in high-pressure regions, protection is typically weak, imposing only limited constraints on economic activity.
abstract_zh: 欧盟将其26%的陆地面积划定为保护区，从而限制经济发展以保护生物多样性。我们利用1985年至2019年间保护区逐步设立的过程，研究保护区的选址机制以及保护措施对植被覆盖率和夜间灯光数据的因果效应。研究发现，在四十年间、不同国家、不同保护批次或不同土地特征下，保护措施对上述两项指标均未产生显著影响。这种零效应与欧盟土地保护的政治经济学逻辑一致：内部化生物多样性收益的激励不足、"绿色光环"动机以及基于面积的目标设定，共同塑造了地方选址与保护强度的选择。实践中，严格保护措施往往施加于开发压力较低的区域——因此保护效果甚微——而在高开发压力地区，保护措施通常较为薄弱，对经济活动仅构成有限约束。

title: Under the wing: The effect of parental proximity on intimate partner violence and underreporting
title_zh: 庇护之下：父母邻近性对亲密伴侣暴力及其低报率的影响
title_primary: 庇护之下：父母邻近性对亲密伴侣暴力及其低报率的影响
title_secondary: Under the wing: The effect of parental proximity on intimate partner violence and underreporting
authors: Mukhlisa Egamberdieva, Nikita Zakharov
abstract: Does proximity to the natal family protect women against intimate partner violence (IPV)? Leveraging Uzbekistan as a natural laboratory and an original list experiment among 835 married women, we find that women near their parents show a list-experiment prevalence estimate of 9.4% and no detectable reporting gap, whereas those far from their parents report only 8.5% in direct surveys, against a list-experiment estimate of 36.2%. Standard surveys do not merely undercount these victims — they invert the ranking of risk, making the most vulnerable women appear the safest. A parallel attitude experiment supports neither preference falsification nor cultural selection.
abstract_zh: 靠近原生家庭能否保护女性免受亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）侵害？以乌兹别克斯坦为自然实验场，通过对835名已婚女性开展原始列表实验，我们发现：与父母同住的女性在列表实验中遭受暴力的估计比例为9.4%，且未发现可检测的报告偏差；而远离父母的女性在直接调查中仅报告8.5%的暴力发生率，但列表实验估计值却高达36.2%。传统调查不仅低估了这些受害者的数量——更彻底颠倒了风险排序，使最脆弱的女性反而显得最安全。平行态度实验的结果既不支持偏好伪装假说，也不支持文化选择假说。

title: General equilibrium effects of technical non‐tariff measures: evidence from bilateral trade cost estimates
title_zh: 技术性非关税措施的一般均衡效应：基于双边贸易成本估计的证据
title_primary: 技术性非关税措施的一般均衡效应：基于双边贸易成本估计的证据
title_secondary: General equilibrium effects of technical non‐tariff measures: evidence from bilateral trade cost estimates
authors: Octavio Fernández‐Amador, Joseph Francois, Achim Vogt
abstract: We estimate the trade and income effects of regulatory developments concerning standard‐like non‐tariff measures (NTMs) over 2012–2017 combining structural gravity estimates and general equilibrium projections. The trade cost effects of regulatory changes vary at the country‐pair level and across sectors. Overall, NTM‐related regulatory changes over 2012–2017 increased trade costs in goods, which reduced global trade by 1.2%. The majority of this reduction corresponds to a decline in goods trade equivalent to about 40% of the actual worldwide decrease of nominal goods trade over this period. Yet the implied reduction of real income is small. We highlight significant variation of these effects at the country and sector level, and show that excluding pair‐specific trade frictions and third‐country effects introduces omitted variable bias. Our findings imply that advances in international coordination of technical regulation can further reduce trade frictions and enhance trade and real income.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文结合结构引力估计与一般均衡预测，评估了2012–2017年间标准类非关税措施监管变化对贸易和收入的影响。监管变化的贸易成本效应在国家-行业层面存在异质性。总体而言，2012–2017年间与非关税措施相关的监管变化提高了商品贸易成本，导致全球贸易下降1.2%。这一降幅中，大部分对应商品贸易的减少量，约占同期全球名义商品贸易实际下降幅度的40%。然而，由此导致的实际收入下降幅度较小。我们强调这些效应在国家与行业层面存在显著差异，并表明忽略国家-行业特定贸易摩擦及第三国效应会引入遗漏变量偏误。研究结果表明，技术监管国际协调的进展可进一步减少贸易摩擦，促进贸易与实际收入增长。

title: Never normal: Distributional properties of rare earth returns
title_zh: 永不正常：稀土收益的分布特征
title_primary: 永不正常：稀土收益的分布特征
title_secondary: Never normal: Distributional properties of rare earth returns
authors: L. Obojska, A. Charteris, J. Szczygielski, Janusz Brzeszczyński
abstract: Rare earth elements are critical to national economic security. However, the distributional properties of rare earth returns remain largely underexplored. We fit 81 distributions to 17 rare earth oxide (REO) return series using three goodness-of-fit criteria. Heavy-tailed distributions—Generalised Hyperbolic, Normal Inverse Gaussian, Cauchy, noncentral t, Student’s t and Generalised Error distributions—dominate, consistent with evidence for commodity markets, although some REO series exhibit more extreme tail behaviour. Some series also exhibit asymmetry. These findings have implications for risk assessment, forecasting, volatility and connectedness modelling, and for any future pricing of REO derivatives, where standard frameworks may understate tail risk.
abstract_zh: 稀土元素对国家经济安全至关重要。然而，稀土收益的分布特性在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。我们运用三种拟合优度标准，将81种分布拟合至17个稀土氧化物（REO）收益序列。重尾分布——广义双曲分布、正态逆高斯分布、柯西分布、非中心t分布、学生t分布及广义误差分布——占据主导地位，这与大宗商品市场的证据一致，尽管部分REO序列表现出更极端的尾部行为。部分序列还呈现不对称性。这些发现对风险评估、预测、波动率及关联性建模，以及对未来REO衍生品定价具有重要意义，在这些领域中，标准框架可能低估尾部风险。

title: A land management, biodiversity preservation, and climate change mitigation analysis in Brazil
title_zh: 巴西土地管理、生物多样性保护与气候变化减缓分析
title_primary: 巴西土地管理、生物多样性保护与气候变化减缓分析
title_secondary: A land management, biodiversity preservation, and climate change mitigation analysis in Brazil
authors: GUSTAVO DA SILVEIRA SCHIAVO, Annibal Scavarda, Virgínia Bodolica, Shahadat Khan, Luiz Felipe Scavarda
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This research aimed to evaluate Brazil's performance in achieving the goals and targets related to Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) 13 (Climate Change) and SDG 15 (Life on Land), while systematically assessing how governmental actions align with the mitigation hierarchy (avoidance, minimization, restoration, offsetting, and enhancement). Based on a qualitative content analysis of scientific literature and official evaluation reports, this work contributes to the debate on climate change and biodiversity loss. The research identifies areas of progress and areas that still require attention from policymakers in this context. This study was developed with a qualitative approach and was structured in two stages, namely the scoping review and documentary research based on data retrieved the Institute of Applied Economic Research (IPEA), a foundation linked to the Brazilian Ministry of Planning and Budget. Documentary research identified reports evaluating Brazil's progress on SDG 13 and SDG 15, and document analysis revealed that Brazil has action plans with varying levels of achievement (fully achieved, partially achieved, and not achieved targets) related to biodiversity preservation, climate change mitigation, and sustainable development. Based on the Brazilian actions to mitigate impacts, it was possible to observe a hierarchy with a stronger emphasis on preservation (avoidance) compared to restoration actions, particularly in land management and biodiversity preservation. Furthermore, key points of progress and areas requiring attention from policymakers regarding this topic were also identified. In view of the need for progress in public policies focused on land management and on addressing climate change and biodiversity loss, this research advances the understanding of how integrated mitigation strategies can support the joint achievement of SDG 13 and SDG 15, offering a structured analytical framework to evaluate governmental performance and inform policy design.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在评估巴西在实现可持续发展目标（SDG）13（气候变化）与SDG 15（陆地生物）相关指标方面的表现，同时系统分析政府行动如何遵循减缓层级原则（避免、最小化、恢复、补偿与增强）。基于对科学文献及官方评估报告的定性内容分析，本研究为气候变化与生物多样性丧失的学术讨论提供了新见解。研究识别了该领域已取得的进展及仍需政策制定者关注的问题。本研究采用定性方法，分两个阶段展开：范围综述与文献研究，数据来源于巴西规划与预算部下属的应用经济研究所（IPEA）。文献研究识别了评估巴西在SDG 13与SDG 15进展的报告，文件分析表明，巴西在生物多样性保护、气候变化减缓及可持续发展方面制定了行动计划，但目标实现程度存在差异（完全实现、部分实现及未实现目标）。基于巴西减缓影响的具体行动，可观察到其减缓层级更强调保护（避免）而非恢复行动，尤其在土地管理与生物多样性保护领域。此外，本研究还识别了该议题下政策制定者需关注的进展关键点与待改进领域。鉴于土地管理、气候变化应对及生物多样性丧失治理领域公共政策亟需推进，本研究深化了对整合性减缓策略如何协同实现SDG 13与SDG 15的理解，为评估政府绩效及政策设计提供了结构化分析框架。

title: Louder than Rates: The Systematic Nature of Central Bank Communication
title_zh: 比利率更响亮：央行沟通的系统性本质
title_primary: 比利率更响亮：央行沟通的系统性本质
title_secondary: Louder than Rates: The Systematic Nature of Central Bank Communication
authors: Tiziana Assenza, Fabrice Collard, Dogukan Guney, Philipp Wangner
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Do central banks decide systematically how much to communicate when explaining their policy decisions? Using all U.S. Federal Open Market Committee policy statements since 1994, we measure communication effort through the change in Shannon entropy and estimate a forward-looking communication rule. We find that communication is systematic: the Federal Reserve communicates more when inflation is expected to exceed target and output is expected to fall below potential. This finding is robust across a variety of sensitivity exercises. We then develop a New Keynesian model with imperfect information showing that systematic communication acts as a second policy instrument, stabilizing expectations and complementing interest-rate policy, especially at the zero lower bound.
abstract_zh: 中央银行在解释其政策决策时，是否会系统性地决定沟通程度？我们利用1994年以来美国联邦公开市场委员会的所有政策声明，通过香农熵的变化衡量沟通努力程度，并估算前瞻性沟通规则。研究发现沟通具有系统性：当预期通胀将超过目标值、产出将低于潜在水平时，美联储会加强沟通。这一结论在多种敏感性检验中保持稳健。我们进一步构建包含不完全信息的新凯恩斯模型，证明系统性沟通作为第二政策工具，能够稳定预期并补充利率政策效力，尤其在零利率下限环境下效果显著。

title: Creative destruction in economic growth
title_zh: 经济增长中的创造性破坏
title_primary: 经济增长中的创造性破坏
title_secondary: Creative destruction in economic growth
authors: Ufuk Akcigit
abstract: The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences awarded the 2025 Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel to Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion, and Peter Howitt “for having explained innovation‐driven economic growth”. Mokyr's work explains why sustained growth was historically rare: prosperity required societies capable of generating, diffusing, and applying useful knowledge. The theory of creative destruction established by Aghion and Howitt explains why economic progress is inherently disruptive, as new technologies continuously replace older technologies, firms, and rents. In this paper, I argue that these ideas moved innovation from the periphery to the center of growth economics and recast growth theory as a dynamic process driven by experimentation, rivalry, entry, and reallocation. Recent research has extended these insights in numerous directions, including heterogeneous firms, business dynamism, talent allocation, artificial intelligence, and green innovation. I conclude by arguing that the central challenge of modern growth policy is not simply to accelerate innovation, but to sustain institutions that keep economies open to creative destruction while preserving competition, broad opportunity, and political support for technological change.
abstract_zh: 瑞典皇家科学院将2025年瑞典中央银行纪念阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔经济学奖授予乔尔·莫基尔、菲利普·阿吉翁和彼得·霍伊特，以表彰他们“解释了创新驱动的经济增长”。莫基尔的研究解释了为何持续增长在历史上极为罕见：繁荣需要社会具备生成、传播和应用有用知识的能力。阿吉翁与霍伊特建立的创造性破坏理论则阐明，经济进步本质上具有颠覆性，因为新技术不断取代旧技术、旧企业和旧租金。本文认为，这些思想将创新从增长经济学的边缘推向核心，并将增长理论重塑为由实验、竞争、进入和重新配置驱动的动态过程。近期研究已将这些洞见拓展至多个方向，包括异质性企业、商业活力、人才配置、人工智能和绿色创新。最后，本文指出现代增长政策的核心挑战并非简单加速创新，而是维持那些使经济对创造性破坏保持开放的制度，同时保护竞争、广泛机遇以及技术变革的政治支持。

title: Tracing investors' minds: Investors’ inquiries and key audit matter reporting
title_zh: 追踪投资者思维：投资者问询与关键审计事项报告
title_primary: 追踪投资者思维：投资者问询与关键审计事项报告
title_secondary: Tracing investors' minds: Investors’ inquiries and key audit matter reporting
authors: Songsheng Chen, Chan Li, Lili Sun, Xiren Zhang
abstract: This study investigates whether auditors incorporate investor information demand when determining key audit matter (KAM) disclosures. We measure investor information demand using a unique dataset of investor inquiries submitted through investor interactive platforms (IIPs) established by the China Securities Regulatory Commission. At the topic level, we find that auditors are more likely to disclose a given topic as a KAM when investors raise more inquiries on that topic. At the aggregate level, a higher proportion of inquiries devoted to accounting issues is associated with both a greater number of KAMs and longer KAM disclosures. Importantly, following the introduction of KAM reporting, managers’ footnote disclosures become more aligned with heightened investor inquiries, reinforcing our interpretation that the documented effects reflect auditors’ responses to investor inquiries rather than merely mirroring managerial disclosure changes. Overall, our findings suggest that auditors incorporate investor information demand into KAM disclosures.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨审计师在确定关键审计事项（KAM）披露时，是否纳入投资者信息需求。我们利用中国证券监督管理委员会设立的投资者互动平台（IIPs）上提交的投资者问询独特数据集来衡量投资者信息需求。在主题层面，我们发现当投资者对某一主题提出更多问询时，审计师更有可能将该主题作为关键审计事项进行披露。在总体层面，涉及会计问题的问询比例越高，关键审计事项的数量越多，其披露内容也越长。重要的是，在关键审计事项报告引入后，管理层脚注披露与投资者问询的增加更加一致，这强化了我们的解释，即所记录的影响反映了审计师对投资者问询的回应，而非仅仅是对管理层披露变化的镜像反映。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，审计师将投资者信息需求纳入关键审计事项披露中。

title: Reducing trade with Russia: Sanctions vs. firms’ voluntary suspension of activities
title_zh: 减少与俄罗斯的贸易：制裁与企业自愿暂停活动
title_primary: 减少与俄罗斯的贸易：制裁与企业自愿暂停活动
title_secondary: Reducing trade with Russia: Sanctions vs. firms’ voluntary suspension of activities
authors: Juan de Lucio, Raúl Mínguez, Asier Minondo, Francisco Requena
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 led to large and unprecedented sanctions against Russia. In parallel, many multinational firms voluntarily decided to suspend their activities in Russia. Using Spanish firm-level data, this paper quantifies the impact of trade sanctions and firms’ voluntary decisions to suspend activities on exports and imports with Russia. We find that firms’ voluntary decisions to suspend activities in Russia contributed to the reduction in exports and imports by 20% and 24%, respectively, while sanctions contributed by 10% and 34%, respectively. The results show that the combination of sanctions and firms’ voluntary suspension of activities caused a much greater reduction in trade with Russia than sanctions alone would have achieved.
abstract_zh: 2022年2月对乌克兰的入侵导致了对俄罗斯大规模且前所未有的制裁。与此同时，许多跨国公司自愿决定暂停在俄罗斯的业务。利用西班牙企业层面的数据，本文量化了贸易制裁及企业自愿暂停业务的决定对与俄罗斯进出口的影响。我们发现，企业自愿暂停在俄罗斯业务的决定分别导致出口和进口减少了20%和24%，而制裁则分别贡献了10%和34%的减少。结果表明，制裁与企业自愿暂停业务的结合，对与俄罗斯贸易的削减效果远大于仅靠制裁所能达到的程度。

title: Production Gaps Among Farmers With Disabilities Are Associated With Limited Technology
title_zh: 残疾农民的生产差距与有限技术相关
title_primary: 残疾农民的生产差距与有限技术相关
title_secondary: Production Gaps Among Farmers With Disabilities Are Associated With Limited Technology
authors: Francis Tsiboe, Edward Martey, Jacob Asravor
abstract: In sub‐Saharan Africa, agriculture is vital; however, the systematic exclusion of persons with disabilities from farming hinders sustainable development and social equity. Although several studies have analyzed productivity differentials across various dimensions of social exclusion, empirical evidence on technology access, farming efficiency, and productivity gaps among farmers with disabilities remains limited. This study addresses this gap by evaluating disparities in crop production between farmers with and without disabilities in Ghana, with a particular focus on differences in technology endowment and production efficiency. Utilizing the meta‐stochastic frontier analysis coupled with statistical matching techniques on nationally representative farm‐level data from the 2012/13 and 2016/17 agricultural seasons, we find negligible differences in technical efficiency between the two groups (less than 0.5%). However, the productive capacity of the technology sets employed by farmers with disabilities is approximately 11%‐point lower than that of their counterparts without disability, resulting in a 9.5%‐point shortfall in crop production. This production shortfall is primarily driven by reduced per‐hectare use of critical inputs such as planting materials, labor, fertilizer, and agro‐chemicals. These findings highlight a significant disability‐associated technology access gap that reflects broader structural inequalities. Addressing these disparities is essential for promoting equitable agricultural development while harnessing the full potential of all farmers in Ghana.
abstract_zh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲，农业至关重要；然而，残疾人被系统性地排斥在农业生产之外，阻碍了可持续发展与社会公平。尽管已有研究分析了社会排斥不同维度下的生产率差异，但关于残疾农民在技术获取、耕作效率及生产率差距方面的实证证据仍然有限。本研究通过评估加纳残疾与非残疾农民在作物生产中的差异，特别是技术禀赋与生产效率的差异，填补了这一空白。基于2012/13和2016/17农业季全国代表性农户层面数据，采用元随机前沿分析结合统计匹配技术，我们发现两组农民的技术效率差异微乎其微（低于0.5%）。然而，残疾农民所采用技术集的生产能力比非残疾农民低约11个百分点，导致作物产量减少9.5个百分点。这一产量缺口主要源于种植材料、劳动力、化肥及农用化学品等关键投入要素的每公顷使用量减少。这些发现揭示了与残疾相关的显著技术获取差距，反映了更广泛的结构性不平等。解决这些差距对于促进公平的农业发展、同时充分发挥加纳所有农民的潜力至关重要。

title: Cryptocurrency Bubbles and Costly Mining
title_zh: 加密货币泡沫与高成本挖矿

I would like to thank Randall Wright for his invaluable guidance, and Erwan Quintin and Marzena Rostek for their continuous support. title: Reference dependence and lottery participation
title_zh: 参考依赖与彩票参与
title_primary: 参考依赖与彩票参与
title_secondary: Reference dependence and lottery participation
authors: Robertas Zubrickas
abstract: We assume that lottery participants are poor relative to their target income. Reference dependence with loss aversion can render the marginal utility of income non-monotonic in line with the Friedman–Savage hypothesis. As a result, lottery participation can be rationalized without invoking probability weighting. The theoretical implications align with recent empirical evidence on lottery spending.
abstract_zh: 我们假设彩票参与者相对于其目标收入而言较为贫困。基于损失厌恶的参照依赖可能导致收入边际效用非单调，这与弗里德曼-萨维奇假说相符。因此，无需借助概率加权即可合理化彩票参与行为。理论推论与近期关于彩票支出的实证证据相一致。

title: Competition and payments to African chiefs on the Gold Coast during the slave trade, 1679‒1704
title_zh: 1679‒1704年奴隶贸易期间黄金海岸的竞争与对非洲酋长的支付
title_primary: 1679‒1704年奴隶贸易期间黄金海岸的竞争与对非洲酋长的支付
title_secondary: Competition and payments to African chiefs on the Gold Coast during the slave trade, 1679‒1704
authors: Jose Rowell Corpuz
abstract: The manuscript records of the Royal African Company show that the Company paid African chiefs for access to trade along the caravan routes on the Gold Coast in the seventeenth century. This paper documents and examines these payments. Using an event study, I establish that after the Glorious Revolution in 1688 when the Company's monopoly in trade over West Africa became uncertain, it resulted in greater competition from other English merchants, making the Company increase its payments to African chiefs whose cooperation was essential to deter other English merchants from competing with the Company. The highest‐ranking chiefs received the highest value of payments per capita. Company records show that firearms (including gunpowder), alcohol, and an expensive type of cloth were the most sought‐after types of payment, and head chiefs received most of these items.
abstract_zh: 皇家非洲公司的档案记录显示，该公司在十七世纪向黄金海岸 caravan 路线上的非洲酋长支付费用以获取贸易通道。本文记录并考察了这些支付行为。通过事件研究法，我发现在1688年光荣革命后，该公司在西非贸易中的垄断地位变得不确定，导致其他英国商人的竞争加剧，从而使公司增加了对非洲酋长的支付，因为他们的合作对于阻止其他英国商人与公司竞争至关重要。地位最高的酋长获得了最高的人均支付价值。公司记录显示，火器（包括火药）、酒精和一种昂贵的布料是最受欢迎的支付物品，而首领酋长获得了这些物品中的大部分。

title: Instrumental variables analysis of COVID-19 vaccination in Moscow
title_zh: 莫斯科新冠疫苗接种的工具变量分析
title_primary: 莫斯科新冠疫苗接种的工具变量分析
title_secondary: Instrumental variables analysis of COVID-19 vaccination in Moscow
authors: Ivan Gordeev
abstract: This article examines the effect of COVID-19 vaccination on the disease dynamics in Moscow using an instrumental variables (IV) approach. Based on weekly data on cases, deaths, and mobility, I compare ordinary least squares (OLS) results with two-stage least squares (TSLS) estimates, addressing endogeneity in vaccination and behaviour. The TSLS estimates imply that the effect on new cases is about 10 times larger than suggested by OLS, indicating a substantial downward bias in naïve models. Moreover, the two doses of Sputnik V have distinct effects: the first mainly lowers infection risk, while the second notably reduces mortality among infected individuals. These findings underscore the importance of high vaccination coverage, clear public communication, and integration of behavioural dynamics as critical elements of public health policy in large urban settings.
abstract_zh: 本文采用工具变量（IV）方法，考察了COVID-19疫苗接种对莫斯科疾病动态的影响。基于每周病例、死亡及流动性数据，我将普通最小二乘法（OLS）结果与两阶段最小二乘法（TSLS）估计进行比较，以处理疫苗接种与行为中的内生性问题。TSLS估计表明，对新发病例的影响约为OLS所提示的10倍，表明朴素模型中存在显著的下行偏差。此外，Sputnik V疫苗的两剂接种具有不同效果：第一剂主要降低感染风险，而第二剂则显著降低感染者死亡率。这些发现强调了高疫苗接种覆盖率、清晰的公共沟通以及将行为动态纳入考量，作为大型城市环境中公共卫生政策关键要素的重要性。

title: Macroprudential, Monetary Policy Synergies and Credit Supply: Evidence from Matched Bank‐Firm Loan‐Level Data in Brazil
title_zh: 宏观审慎与货币政策的协同效应及信贷供给：基于巴西银行-企业贷款匹配数据的实证研究
title_primary: 宏观审慎与货币政策的协同效应及信贷供给：基于巴西银行-企业贷款匹配数据的实证研究
title_secondary: Macroprudential, Monetary Policy Synergies and Credit Supply: Evidence from Matched Bank‐Firm Loan‐Level Data in Brazil
authors: RODRIGO BARBONE GONZALEZ, JOÃO BARATA RIBEIRO BLANCO BARROSO, BERNARDUS FERDINANDUS NAZAR VAN DOORNIK
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
abstract: This paper estimates the impact of countercyclical reserve requirements (RRs) on credit. We explore differential bank exposure to RRs in matched loan‐level data from Brazil, where RRs have been used extensively to pursue financial stability. We find that, after tightening RRs, more exposed banks reduce credit to firms; after loosening, they expand credit supply. During booms, private domestic banks with lower capital are more responsive to a tightening of RRs and to a simultaneous tightening of the short‐term policy rate. We also find that higher levels of economic policy uncertainty weaken this channel, and real effects in employment are modest.
abstract_zh: 本文估算了逆周期存款准备金率（RRs）对信贷的影响。我们利用巴西的匹配贷款级数据，探讨了银行对RRs的不同敞口，该国广泛运用RRs以追求金融稳定。研究发现，在收紧RRs后，敞口较大的银行减少了对企业的信贷；而在放松后，则扩大了信贷供给。在经济繁荣时期，资本充足率较低的私人国内银行对RRs收紧及短期政策利率同步上调的反应更为敏感。我们还发现，经济政策不确定性的上升会削弱这一传导渠道，且对就业的实际影响较为温和。

title: Disagreement and Scheduled Announcements: Explaining the Pre-Announcement Drift
title_zh: 分歧与预定公告：解释公告前漂移
title_primary: 分歧与预定公告：解释公告前漂移
title_secondary: Disagreement and Scheduled Announcements: Explaining the Pre-Announcement Drift
authors: Cocoma, Paula
source: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
abstract: This article proposes a theoretical explanation for the positive pre-announcement drift empirically documented ahead of scheduled announcements, using the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings as a main example. The framework entails a general equilibrium model of disagreement (differences of opinion), where investors interpret a costly signal differently. Investors optimally decide to stop learning when an announcement is imminent, increasing the risk premium ahead of an announcement. The model jointly rationalizes puzzling empirical evidence by generating i) an upward drift in prices just before scheduled announcements, regardless of the announcement’s content, which coexists with ii) low volatility and iii) low trading volume.
abstract_zh: 本文针对定期公告前实证记录的正向预公告漂移现象，提出了一种理论解释，主要以联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）会议为例。该框架包含一个分歧（意见差异）的一般均衡模型，其中投资者对成本信号的解读各不相同。投资者在公告临近时最优地决定停止学习，从而在公告前增加风险溢价。该模型通过生成以下现象共同合理化令人困惑的实证证据：i) 在定期公告前价格出现上行漂移，无论公告内容如何，同时伴随 ii) 低波动性和 iii) 低交易量。

title: How in-group favoritism affects individual donation decisions: A laboratory experimental study
title_zh: 内群体偏爱如何影响个人捐赠决策：一项实验室实验研究
title_primary: 内群体偏爱如何影响个人捐赠决策：一项实验室实验研究
title_secondary: How in-group favoritism affects individual donation decisions: A laboratory experimental study
authors: Hui-Chun Peng
abstract: This paper uses a multi-recipient dictator game to examine whether in-group favoritism increases donations to in-group institutions but decreases donations to out-group institutions. By comparing individual donations to in-group institutions, out-group institutions, and total donations in different treatments, I find that the total donations are similar in different treatments, but the donations each institution receives are different. Individuals donate equally when they encounter two out-group institutions, but, they tend to donate a larger amount to the in-group institution and a smaller amount to the out-group institution. These results demonstrate that donations to the in-group institution due to the effect of in-group favoritism increase at the expense of donations to the out-group institution.
abstract_zh: 本文采用多接受者独裁者博弈实验，考察内群体偏袒是否会增加对内群体机构的捐赠，同时减少对外群体机构的捐赠。通过比较不同实验处理中个体对内群体机构、外群体机构及总捐赠额的差异，本研究发现：不同处理下的总捐赠额相近，但各机构获得的捐赠额存在差异。当个体面对两个外群体机构时，其捐赠行为呈现均等化特征；然而，当面对内群体机构与外群体机构时，个体倾向于向内群体机构捐赠更多金额，而向外群体机构捐赠更少金额。这些结果表明，内群体偏袒效应导致对内群体机构的捐赠增加，是以牺牲对外群体机构的捐赠为代价的。
